title: Meet the 2026 Executive Board
excerpt: A new team takes the controls. Here is the bureau leading Centrale Aero Club (CAC) this year — and what we are planning.
content:
Centrale Aero Club (CAC) is proud to announce its new executive board for the 2026 mandate, led by President Lina Assabane.

The new bureau brings together 24 members across the executive team, events, sponsoring, communication, design, and our two technical departments — Aeronautics, headed by Adam Sabili, and Aerospace, headed by Anouar Mounaim.

This year's roadmap is our most ambitious yet: the first edition of Aero Day, participation in national aerospace challenges, company visits to Safran and Royal Air Maroc, and of course the return of Space Day and our astronomy nights.

Stay tuned — and if the sky calls you, the Join Us page is open.
author: Communication Team

title: Space Day 2025 — Recap
excerpt: AI, Earth observation and space engineering: a look back at our flagship event.
content:
Space Day 2025 gathered students, researchers and industry guests for a full day dedicated to space.

Talks covered artificial intelligence applied to space systems, Earth observation for Morocco, and the fundamentals of space engineering. Project demos from both departments rounded out the day.

Thank you to every speaker, partner and volunteer who made it happen. Space Day will be back — bigger.
author: Communication Team
